_comment: s70001 gi111 (d5 b200): the turn-6 board of the land-only turn-2 line, where the combat finishers
(MTG_AA_COMBO_COMBAT) made the game a turn slower. Seven Forests (the land drop made), a non-sick Accomplished
Alchemist; hand Weather the Storm, Ezuri, Crab Umbra, Staff of Domination; a Stroke of Genius 20 cards down;
opponent at 20. The main-phase route is six links: Weather (X = 3), Crab Umbra off the Alchemist's blue, the Staff,
its gain (X = 4), the Umbra loop drawing to the Stroke, Stroke at the opponent (LIFE-HAND+LOOP-STAFF-HAND+
FIN-STAFF-DIG; 60 applies). With the combat finishers live the walk also admits every Ezuri cast as a setup and
spends its whole bound (128 applies) on them without proving anything. Proved by MTG_AA_ROUTE_PUMP_SETUP_LAST
(Ezuri casts ordered in the finish stage: 100 applies) and, independently, by MTG_AA_ROUTE_MAIN_FIRST (the
main-phase pass). With both =0 the button is unproven and the click fails.
